description: Create a public progress page for an event (needs an API key whose contact e-mail is confirmed; max 10 per day). The event is unlisted: it is reachable by its URL but not featured in the catalogue or sitemap. Dates are inclusive calendar days.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, not before start_date.

language.description: Language of the page. Default en.
